release_notes:
🚀 CineMax v2.0.0 is available now!

⚠️ Important: After installing this update, please uninstall the old version of CineMax

🏛️ Architectural Overhaul & Core Restructuring:
- Complete MVI modernization for hubs, search, and details with massive performance boosts, instant caching, and fluid 60FPS animations.

💬 Direct Subtitle Downloader:
- Download multilingual subtitles directly for offline viewing with seamless automatic player integration.

📥 Background Download Engine 2.0:
- Rock-solid background downloading with live Android notification progress, high-speed multi-threaded chunks, and auto-retry.

⚡ High-Speed Streaming Servers:
- Expanded fast-streaming direct CDN servers with automatic best-server selection and unreleased episode countdowns.

👑 CineMax Blade 2.0 & VIP System:
- Signature 3D gold blade vector icons, VIP perks, full RTL Arabic layout support, and advanced bilingual typography scaling.

🎬 Dedicated Hubs & Scoped Search:
- All-new Arabic Cinema and Anime Hubs with proscenium billboard carousels and multi-source parallel scoped search.
